description_en: Guji Bāhāḥ, also known as Divyadivākarasaṃskārita Vaiśravarṇa Mahāvihāra, is one of the major Bāhāḥ of Patan. The Bāhāḥ is located to the right of the street that runs to Saugalhiti from Lũhiti (Sundhārā). The complex has two entrances; one at the north and another to the south. Its northern entrance is marked by a large Licchavicaitya.The Bāhāḥ's main shrine building is on the southern wing. The three-storey building is decorated with images of Buddhist deities on the cornice of the second floor and carved struts that support the overhanging metal roof. The pinnacle of the monument is a set of threestūpas;the centralstūpais covered with achatraand marked with a metal flag. Guardian lions protect the entrance of the sanctum, which is clad in brass sheets and boasts two metal flags and a floral archway. Above the door, atoraṇadisplays an image of Mahārāgamañjuśrī and two other deities. A central five-foldpasukājhyāḥwith two small blind windows can be found on either side of the façade of the first floor. The second floor also boasts a large window with a central opening and two latticed screens.Theāgãcheof the Bāhāḥ is located on the first floor. The main entrance of theāgãchehas a surmountingtoraṇawith images of Nāmasaṅgīti Mañjuśrī, Siddhigaṇeśa and Mahākāla. The sanctum houses a large image of Akṣobhya facing north, as well as several other gilded and bronze Bodhisattva images.There is aśikharakūṭa caitya, adharmadhātujinālaya caitya, adharmadhātu maṇḍalaand ayajñakuṇḍain the courtyard.The earliest reference to this Bāhāḥ is in a manuscript copy of theKriyāsaṅgrahapañjikā, copied in NS 373 (1252 CE). The antiquity of the place is reflected in the Licchavi-eracaityathat stands in front of the northern entrance to the Bāhāḥ.
description_ne: ललितपुरमा रहेका मूबाहा: मध्ये गुजि बाहा: पनि एक हो । यसको पूरा नाम दिव्यदिवाकरसंस्कारित वैश्रवर्ण महाविहार हो । बाहा:को नाममा रहेको दिवाकर र वैश्रवर्ण भन्ने व्यक्तिबारे इतिहासमा कहीँ उल्लेख गरिएको पाइँदैन । वैश्रवर्ण प्रसिद्ध विद्वान् एवं तान्त्रिक गयोभाजु योगेन्द्रानन्द राजोपाध्यायका भाइ हुन् र जीर्ण अवस्थामा रहेको बाहा:लाई वैश्रदेवले जीर्णोद्धार गरेका थिए भन्ने जनविश्वास छ । यो बाहा:को पुरानो नाम ग्वाछे बाहा: (ग्वाक्षे बाहा:) शब्द नै अपभ्रंश हुँदै अहिलेको नाम गुजिबाहाः भएको हो ।यो बाहा:मा दुईवटा मूलद्वार छन् । चालाछेँबाट दक्षिणतिर लिच्छवि चैत्य भएको चोकबाट भित्र जाने द्वार नयाँ हो । चालाछेँबाट दक्षिणतिर लागी पूर्वपट्टि मोडिएपछि पुगिने ढोका पुरानो मूलद्वार हो । नयाँ मूलद्वार सादा छ जसबाट भित्र पसेपछि दायाँ-बायाँ फल्चा देखिन्छन् । नयाँ मूलद्वारको ठीक सामुन्ने बाहा:को द्य:छेँ रहेको छ । पुरानो मूलद्वारको माथि पञ्चबुद्ध र दायाँ-बायाँ पूर्णकलशको साथमा सुगा र एक जोर आँखाको चित्र बनाइएको छ । एक तहको छाना र तीनतले बाहा:को द्य:छेँ उत्तराभिमुख गरी बनाइएको छ । बाहा:को छाना पहिले झिँगटीले छाइएको थियो भने अहिले तामाको पाताको छाना छ । छानामाथि तीनवटा सुवर्ण चैत्यलाई गजूरको रूपमा राखिएको छ । गजूरदेखि पहिलो तलाको पासुखा झ्यालसम्म पुग्ने गरी पता: झुण्ड्याइएको छ । छाना अड्याउन महावज्रसत्त्व र पञ्चमहाबुद्ध अंकित ६ वटा टुँडाल राखिएका छन् । दोस्रो तलामा बीचमा कलात्मक झ्याल राखी दायाँ-बायाँ एक-एकवटा तिकि झ्या: राखिएका छन् । यस तलाको छेउछेउमा भाँडाकुँडा र हतियारहरू झुण्ड्याइएका छन् । द्य:छेँको पहिलो तलाको बीचमा पासुखाझ्याल राखी दायाँ-बायाँ एक-एकवटा बाकूझ्याल (halved windows) राखिएका छन् । दुबै बाकूझ्यालको माथि बुद्धको धातुमूर्ति राखिएको छ । पासुखाझ्यालको माथि पञ्चबुद्ध र ताराको धातुको मूर्ति राखिएको छ । पञ्चबुद्धको मूर्तिभन्दा माथि पहिले पञ्चबुद्ध, तारा र सालभञ्जिकाका चित्रहरू कोरिएका थिए भने अहिले धातुको मूर्ति नै बनाएर राखिएको छ । द्य:छेँको पहिलो तलामा बाहा:को गर्भगृह रहेको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र आभूषणद्वारा सुसज्जित ढुंगाबाट निर्मित अक्षोभ्य बुद्धलाई क्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । क्वा:पा:द्य:को शरीरलाई हेगाले छोपिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोकामाथि महाराग मञ्जुश्री केन्द्रमा रहेको धातुको तोरण राखिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोकालाई पित्तलको पाताले मोडिएको छ । ढोकाको दायाँ-बायाँ सारिपुत्र र मौद्गल्यायनको धातुको प्रतिमा राखिएका छन् । ढोकाको दायाँ-बायाँ एक-एकवटा साना झ्याल छन् । गर्भगृहमा जाने सिँढीको दायाँ-बायाँ एक जोडी ढुंगाको सिंह र पित्तलको झण्डा राखिएका छन् ।बाहा: परिसरमा धातुको यज्ञकुण्ड, एउटा धर्मधातु, एउटा शिखरकूट चैत्य र एउटा धर्मधातु जिनालय चैत्य रहेका छन् । बाहा:को पूर्वमा गुम्बा बनाइएको छ । पहिले यसै ठाउँमा पश्चिमाभिमुख गरी बाहा:को द्य:छेँ बनाइएको थियो । गुम्बामा जाने द्वारको माथि तोरणमा धर्मचक्र महामञ्जुश्री राखिएको छ । बाहा:को उत्तरी मोहडाको पूर्वी छेउमा आगममा जाने द्वार रहेको छ । उक्त द्वारमाथि नामसंगीति मञ्जुश्रीको प्रतिमा बीचमा रहेको तोरण राखिएको छ । मञ्जुश्रीको दायाँ सिद्धिगणेश र बायाँ महाकाल राखिएको छ । बाहा:को पश्चिमी मोहडाको उत्तरी छेउमा आगममा रहेको त्रैलोक्य विजयको प्रतीकस्वरूप वज्र स्थापना गरिएको छ । उत्तरी मोहडाको पहिलो तलामा आगम रहेको ठाउँमा कलात्मक झ्याल राखिएको छ । झ्यालमाथिको तोरणमा वागीश्वर मञ्जुघोषको प्रतिमा छ ।यो बाहा: कहिले बन्यो भन्ने स्पष्ट पार्ने ऐतिहासिक सामग्री उपलब्ध छैन । बाहाः प्राङ्गणमा लिच्छवि चैत्य रहेबाट यो बाहा: निकै पुरानो हो भन्ने देखिन्छ ।यो बाहा:मा पुरानो र नयाँ गरी दुईवटा मूल ढोका रहनुको कारणसँग जोडेर भनिने एउटा किंवदन्ती प्रसिद्ध छ । पहिले यो बाहा:को द्य:छेँ पश्चिमाभिमुख गरी बनाइएको थियो र द्य:छेँको ठीक सामुन्ने रहेको ढोका नै बाहा:को मूलढोका थियो । कुनै समयमा द्य:छेंमा आगलागी भएपछि श्रीखण्डबाट बनेको क्वा:पा:द्य:लाई थैनास्थित सिकुचा बाहा: (LAL2550) मा सारिएको थियो । नेसं १ मा वैश्रवर्ण नामका दानपतिले उत्तराभिमुख गरी हालको स्थानमा क्वा:पा:छेँ बनाइदिए । क्वा:पा:छेँ तयार भइसकेपछि सिकुचा बाहा:मा राखिएको क्वा:पा:द्य: लिन जाँदा उखेल्न नसकिने गरी त्यहीँ सिद्ध भइसकेको थियो । गुजि बाहा:को क्वा:पा:द्य: सिद्ध भएको हुनाले त्यस बाहा:लाई सिद्ध बाहा: भन्न थालियो । पछि अपभ्रंश हुँदै त्यसलाई सिकुचा बाहा: भन्न थालिएको हो (Śākya 2001, 29-30) । बाहा:मा कुनै शुभकार्य वा धार्मिक गतिविधि गर्दा पुरानै मूलद्वारबाट भित्र-बाहिर गर्नुपर्ने प्रावधान रहेको छ ।
brick_type: dāci apā (conical veneer brick), mā apā (regular fired brick)

historical_events.event_name: Donation of finials and a lotus flower
historical_events.event_description: Devajoti, his wife Hālāvati, son Amṛtjoti and grandson Śubhajoti performed a fire ritual worship and made an offering of two finials. Amṛtajoti also donated a lotus flower, which was placed at the center of the goldenilā̃.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of ghee lamps and a statue
historical_events.event_description: Dhãcā Thakũ and other family members donated 32 ghee lamps and an image. Land was also bestowed upon the temple to fund its management.

historical_events.event_name: The earliest mention of Guji Bāhāḥ
historical_events.event_description: The name Guji Bāhāḥ was mentioned in a manuscript entitledKriyāsaṃgrahapañjikā,preserved in the Asiatic Society, Calcutta. This was written during the reign of King Abhaya Malla. In this manuscript, Guji Bāhāḥ is referred to as Vaiśya Śrī Divākara Varmma Mahāvihāra.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of a pair of lion
historical_events.event_description: A pair of stone lions were donated and placed on either side of the entrance to sanctum. This occured whilst Bhimapāla was theThapāḥjuof thevihāra. The donation was made by Amṛtasiṃhadeva, Bitusiṃhadeva, Adikara and others.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of deities with golden toraṇa
historical_events.event_description: Deva, Devajoti and Amṛtajoti donated funds to gild the statue of thebāhāḥ'smain deity. The door of the sanctum and thetoraṇawere also gilded. Images of the Five Buddhas, Vajrapāṇi and Ratnapāṇi were also installed at this time.

historical_events.event_name: Donations
historical_events.event_description: A golden robe was donated to thekvāḥpāḥdyaḥby Devajoti, his son Amṛtajoti and his grandson Śubhajoti.A goldenilā̃was donated to Trailokya Vijaya Āḥju by Devajoti, his son Amṛtjoti and his grandson Śubhajoti.A new storey was added to the esoteric shrine by Thapāḥju Guṇarāja and otherāḥjusof thebāhāḥ.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of a golden window to Trailokya Vijaya Āḥju and Hevajra
historical_events.event_description: A golden window was donated to Trailokya Vijaya Āḥju and Hevajra.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of lāḥphaḥcā
historical_events.event_description: Pañcaratna Śākya (Sānukājī Śākya), his wife Jñānīśobhā Śākya and his family donated thelāḥphaḥcāthat is fixed at the threshold of the sanctum's entrance.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of door and wooden toraṇa to Trailokyā Vijaya Āḥju / Donation of hegā to kvāḥpāḥdyaḥ
historical_events.event_description: Śākyavamśa Manisiṃha, Deva and others donated a woodentoraṇato Trailokyā Vijaya Āḥju and ahegātokvāḥpāḥdyaḥduring the reign of King Śrīnivāsa Malla.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of a pair of flag
historical_events.event_description: Āsāmadu, his son Budharatna, and his daughter Āsāmāyā donated a pair of metal flags.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of brass door leaf
historical_events.event_description: Candrajoti, Prammani, Dhamasāri and others donated a pair of brass door leaves. These were used for the entrance to the sanctum.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of statue of Sāriputra and other images
historical_events.event_description: 1. Munajoti donated a statue of Sāriputra. This was established at the east of the sanctum.2. Munajoti donated atoraṇaand images of Kākāsya-Ulakāsya to Trailokya Vijaya Āḥju.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of statue of Maudgalyāyana
historical_events.event_description: Āsāmadu and his younger brother Sigharāja donated the image of Maudagalyāyana that is placed at the western corner of the sanctum.

historical_events.event_name: Consecration of Dharmadhātujinālaya Caitya
historical_events.event_description: Joganarasiṃha, his son Mutinarasiṃha and the rest of his family built thedharmadhātujinālaya caityain thebāhāḥcourtyard.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of archway in front of the sanctum
historical_events.event_description: Āsāmadu and his wife Hyerāmāyā donated an artistic archway with a floral design and apūrṇakalaśa.These are installed in front of the entrance to the sanctum.

historical_events.event_name: Renovation of monastic building
historical_events.event_description: The monastic building was renovated. Total Rs. 11, 90,939.66 was expended for the renovation. Lalitpur Metropolitan City donated Rs. 4,00000, Rs. 6,46,939.66 was gathered in donations, and Rs. 1,35,000 came from the voluntary labour of local people.

historical_events.event_name: Renovation of Gumbā
historical_events.event_description: Thegumbāon the east of thebāhāḥwas renovated by Lalitpur Sub-metropolitan City and donations of local people.

historical_events.event_name: Covering of upper part of Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala with brass plate
historical_events.event_description: The upper part ofdharmadhātu maṇḍalawas covered with brass plate in the memory of the deceasedthapāḥjuDhana Śākya.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of a maṇḍaḷa in front of sanctum
historical_events.event_description: Thesaṅghamembers of the Guji Bāhāḥ donated a brassmaṇḍalawhich is placed in front of the sanctum.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of dalūpāḥ
historical_events.event_description: Pūrṇa Bahādur Śākya donated 32dalūpāsfor the lamps to be lit in memory of his father Punadeva Śākya and his mother Lakṣmīmāyā Śākya.

historical_events.event_name: Renovation of Digi shrine
historical_events.event_description: Thedigiwas renovated. Rs. 14,29,629 was expended for the renovation. UDLE donated Rs. 4,50,000, Rs. 2,45,277 came from thebāhāḥ'streasury, Rs. 5,52,852 was collected in donations, and Rs. 1,81,500 came from the voluntary labour of local people.
